generation.scope: A generically rank-three distinct opposite matrix must have four linearly independent kernel coordinates on every finite Frobenius window. The ternary case would put a self-annihilating length-ten ideal on a determinantal cubic, where the rank-one condition forces impossible cubic identities. In particular every distinct opposite of an arbitrary curvilinear finite graph gives a nonzero triple octic, with no restriction on local lengths.
